PowerShell($key = \(Get-Content "c:\\Users\\mrast\\OneDrive\\Documents\\The Rasten Cup\\.env" | Where-Object { $_ -match "^API_FOOTBALL_KEY=" }\) -replace "^API_FOOTBALL_KEY=", ""; $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://v3.football.api-sports.io/fixtures?league=1&season=2026&round=Round%20of%2032" -Headers @{ "x-apisports-key" = $key }; Write-Host "R32 fixtures: $\($response.results\)"; $response.response | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.fixture.date.Substring\(0,10\)\)  $\($_.teams.home.name\) vs $\($_.teams.away.name\)  [$\($_.fixture.status.short\)]  $\($_.goals.home\)-$\($_.goals.away\)" })

PowerShell($url = \(Get-Content "c:\\Users\\mrast\\OneDrive\\Documents\\The Rasten Cup\\.env" | Where-Object { $_ -match "^VITE_SUPABASE_URL=" }\) -replace "^VITE_SUPABASE_URL=", ""; $key = \(Get-Content "c:\\Users\\mrast\\OneDrive\\Documents\\The Rasten Cup\\.env" | Where-Object { $_ -match "^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=" }\) -replace "^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=", ""; $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$url/rest/v1/matches?round=eq.R32&select=id,home_team_id,away_team_id,date,status,api_id" -Headers @{ "apikey" = $key; "Authorization" = "Bearer $key" }; $response | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.id\)  home=$\($_.home_team_id\)  away=$\($_.away_team_id\)  api_id=$\($_.api_id\)  date=$\($_.date\)" })

PowerShell($key = \(Get-Content "c:\\Users\\mrast\\OneDrive\\Documents\\The Rasten Cup\\.env" | Where-Object { $_ -match "^API_FOOTBALL_KEY=" }\) -replace "^API_FOOTBALL_KEY=", ""; $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://v3.football.api-sports.io/fixtures?league=1&season=2026&round=Round%20of%2032" -Headers @{ "x-apisports-key" = $key }; $response.response | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.fixture.date\)  |  $\($_.teams.home.name\) vs $\($_.teams.away.name\)" })

PowerShell($url = \(Get-Content "c:\\Users\\mrast\\OneDrive\\Documents\\The Rasten Cup\\.env" | Where-Object { $_ -match "^VITE_SUPABASE_URL=" }\) -replace "^VITE_SUPABASE_URL=", ""; $key = \(Get-Content "c:\\Users\\mrast\\OneDrive\\Documents\\The Rasten Cup\\.env" | Where-Object { $_ -match "^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=" }\) -replace "^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=", ""; $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$url/rest/v1/matches?round=eq.R32&select=id,home_team_id,away_team_id,date,api_id&order=date" -Headers @{ "apikey" = $key; "Authorization" = "Bearer $key" }; $response | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.id\)  $\($_.home_team_id\) vs $\($_.away_team_id\)  $\($_.date\)  api=$\($_.api_id\)" })
